_comment: MXFP8 recipe for the Qwen3.5 family: OCP MXFP8 W8A8 (e4m3, 1x32 blocks, UE8M0 power-of-two scales stored as uint8), dynamic activations. Same keep-list as qwen35_128blockfp8.json. Served on SM120 by sglang's FlashInfer CUTLASS mm_mxfp8; dense layers only, since sglang's MXFP8 MoE is SM100-only.
